D2: THE SCRIPT BY ITS ARGV. Measured 2026-11-13 on Python 3.14.10: at atexit sys.modules['__main__'] carries no __file__, so the reach sitecustomize logged every file a script subprocess loaded except the script itself, and a meta-proof's seal left the proof it ran out of fingerprint_closure (tooth 5 red). The atexit logger now adds os.path.abspath(sys.argv[0]) when argv[0] names a file ('-c' and '' name none). The proof's PROVES names this ticket on tooth 5, which is red on main and green on the branch.

orient.intent: A meta-proof's seal covers the proof it runs again: tooth 5 of the reach proof is green, because the script a subprocess ran is in the reach log on Python 3.14.
unknowns: the Linux python version on the Dell; the fix holds on 3.12 too since argv is a superset
